summary: Verified the view-only (INACTIVE plan) fix on BOTH web and mobile against the shared backend. Backend middleware now correctly reads the authoritative subscriptions doc: view-only writes are blocked with 402 read_only:true across all tested tool/edit endpoints (provider-ratings, documents, v2/participants, participant/wellbeing, participant/concern, chat, family-thread, invoices/upload multipart, statements/upload multipart). Active (cathy) and Trial (trialactive) writes are NOT hit by the read_only middleware (regression clean). Web UI: view-only user visiting /ai-tools/budget-calculator and /ai-tools/invoice-checker sees the top ReadOnlyBanner AND the in-tool tool-locked-banner + tool-lock-gate with a Reactivate CTA; the tool body renders inert (opacity 0.55, pointer-events:none) and the marketing paywall inside the greyed body cannot be interacted with. Active user sees NO lock banner and the tool is fully interactive. Settings/Billing is reachable for view-only users with no lock banner. Mobile: could not seed AsyncStorage token to drive the UI, but API calls made from the mobile-preview origin confirm identical enforcement — view-only POST /provider-ratings returns 402 read_only:true, active POST returns 422 (route-level, NOT 402), GET /billing/subscription returns 200. Mobile allow-list confirmed by code: /public/ removed from _READ_ONLY_ALLOW_PREFIXES in /app/mobile/src/lib/api.ts. Web allow-list confirmed in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js. Backend /api/public/budget-calc remains exempt at middleware level (client-side ToolLockGate + client allow-list are the enforcement layer for that route, as described in the fix).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:7502 correctly fetches db.subscriptions before calling _compute_access_state — matches /auth/me source of truth. Confirmed working end-to-end.
App.js:217-247 ToolLockGate wraps AI tool routes for logged-in non-adviser users; renders tool-locked-banner + inert body. Visually verified working.
Both api.js (web) and api.ts (mobile) allow-lists no longer contain /public/ — Budget Calculator (which posts to /api/public/budget-calc) is blocked client-side for view_only users.
Non-blocking: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js:26 still allow-lists /metrics — worth verifying that endpoint doesn't accept destructive writes; low risk.

Non-blocking: two 2xx-expected GETs (/api/documents, /api/statements) returned 409/400 for the view_only fixture because that fixture has no household context — not related to the bug; simply a fixture data limitation.

rca of the issue: Original bug: /_enforce_read_only_for_unpaid computed access_state from users.subscription_status mirror which lagged behind the authoritative subscriptions doc, so view-only users could POST while UI showed view-only. Fix (verified iter263): middleware now fetches db.subscriptions and passes it into _compute_access_state, matching /auth/me. Second sub-bug: /api/public/budget-calc was exempt server-side and additionally allow-listed on both clients — removed /public/ from client allow-lists AND web wraps AI tool routes in ToolLockGate (inert body + reactivate CTA). All three surfaces verified working.
